newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee auction to total 116,100 bags Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee auction to total 116,100 bags Jan 8.

text.p: The Brazilian government will auction 116,100 60-kg bags of coffee stocks in its next monthly auction on January 8, said Roberto Abreu of the National Coffee Department.
The auction will be the largest so far in a series of monthly sales planned for this coffee year (July/June) but that did not necessarily mean future sales would continue to grow, he said.
"The size of each auction is determined by the market," Abreu said.
In December, the government sold 86,284 60-kg bags of coffee, or 95.85 percent of its auction of 90,018 bags of stocks.

Roasters and exporters have been hoping the government would start to increase the size of the monthly sales in the first half of this year, with some calling for the current limit of 200,000 bags to be raised.
A Banco do Brasil official said the bank, which holds the electronic auction, had still to receive details of the sale.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
